# Data card - synthetic AUTOSAR HLD knowledge base

* **Origin:** fully synthetic. Generated by `Code/scripts/generate_synthetic_data.py` from a Python data model. No OEM, customer or standards text.
* **Purpose:** training and evaluation of the HLD Assistant (case study CS1). Approved-or-synthetic data rule satisfied.
* **Contents (4 PDFs, 2 projects):**

| Project | Document | Version | Status | Pages |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PRJ-BODY | HLD-BCM-001 Door and Access Control | 1.0 | superseded | 6 |
| PRJ-BODY | HLD-BCM-001 Door and Access Control | 1.1 | approved | 6 |
| PRJ-BODY | HLD-DCM-003 Diagnostic Communication and Gateway | 1.0 | approved | 5 |
| PRJ-ENERGY | HLD-BMS-002 Battery Management System | 1.0 | approved | 6 |

* **Template used by every document:** numbered sections; component sections with `Component / Type / Safety Level / Description / Provided Ports / Required Ports / Depends On / Error Handling / Verification`; interface sections; a pipe-separated signal catalogue; functional flows; verification overview; revision history.
* **Seeded defects (12 in the approved documents):** orphan consumer, undefined interface (x2), undefined component (x2), type conflict, duplicate component definition, timing mismatch, missing verification, safety level gap (x2), one instruction-like sentence for the prompt-injection guard. The list is in `Evaluation_Results/ground_truth/issues_seeded.json`.
* **Revision v1.1** fixes two defects of v1.0 (timeout, missing tests) and adds a component, an interface and a signal so that revision comparison has something to find.
* **Limitations:** clean text, one template, no diagrams, no scans, English only.
